sherlock.description: The transient is possibly associated with SDSS J081931-060114.9; a J=17.01 mag galaxy found in the SDSS/2MASS/PS1 catalogues. It's located 1.20 arcsec N, 1.10 arcsec W from the galaxy centre.

TNS.reporters: F. Forster, F.E. Bauer, A. Munoz-Arancibia, L. Hernandez-Garcia, G. Pignata...
